Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Simon Klbisch wrote:
> Is this group still alive? Or am I the only one subscribing this group?

Normal USENET protocol is to read a group for a few days before posting.
Doing so would have shown you that the group is still alive.

For impatient types, check Deja News to see how recent the
most recent posts have been: www.dejanews.com

> So my question:
> Is there anybody in Europe willing to sell his/her Jyhad/Vampire/Sabbat +
> co cards?
> Trades are also welcome.

Trading activity, while not shunned in this group, normally occurs
in rec.trading-cards.marketplace.misc (with the text "[VTES]" or
[JYHAD] in the subject). There are a handful of people who post
lists of Vampire cards for sale or trade there every week.
You may have better luck there.
